title: The p16 query-only shears cannot be fused, re-framed (floor 15 = 15) or absorbed by a gather-type two-query word (no new κ)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"Matarener"} -->
_Requested by **Mark**_

## Change and mathematical scope

**Negative result (exact algebra, an exact floor, a scoped bound); no new κ.** The selected κ is unchanged.

#4470's p16 complex controller and the retained BIT controller each have 15 query-only shears (#4440), at one rank-one job per port. They are 0.7% of each paid moment, but free shears on both sides would give a raw ceiling near 0.0099 (companion PR `productive-lever-reprice`). #4440 lists a changed query/native alphabet as its next question. This package closes three routes, in the replay model of `query-thinned-controllers/controller.py`.

- **Fusion with a neighbouring full call needs two queries.** A thin block nets `Y_{j−1}, Y_j += Q^{-1}(X_{j−1}+X_j)`, while both neighbouring full calls are backward (`X += −QY`). For all 30 fusions per side (previous and next), complex composites have nonzero `Q^1` and `Q^{-1}` coefficients, and BIT composites have Q-coefficient rank 2 over GF(2)(D) (nonzero 2×2 minor). A full call has support `{Q^0, Q^{±1}}` and rank 1 (control).
- **Lazy central frames give nothing.** Exactly, `S_x(−Q)S_y(Q^{-1}) = signed_swap·diag(Q^{-1},Q)·S_x(Q)`, so a query can be traded for parity changes of central frames. In the parity model (flip 1, ADD across parities 1, query free across parities and 1 otherwise, full calls need equal parities, Q² treated as free), each thin query lies in a window that starts at a full call on its own pair and has only ADD/IDLE events. The 15 windows are disjoint, so the cost is ≥ 15, and the controller attains it. A whole-word CP-SAT run agreed (discovery only).
- **A gather-type two-query native word costs at least the present bill.** All 112 complex and 111 BIT query lines are distinct (as in #4580), so a second query needs one rank-one job per port. Riding on an existing query gives `Q(f+u)`, which linearity cannot split. Merging 112 rank-one jobs into 14 rank-eight jobs saves under one unit of moment.

Remaining scope: parts 1–2 are exact in their models. Part 3 covers gather-type schemes only, not every circuit (for example address recodings that make lines meet).

## Task and overlap

- **Card.** `complex-new-helper-inventory`, priority revision 7. Scope **changed**: it tests #4440's query-interface question and builds no interface (TASK.json).
- **Base.** `f626db5c3a3d781d8f7695038776c621651f75e1`. Inputs pinned in SOURCES.json.
- **Overlap.** #4440/#4470 (controllers), #4516 (independent p16 replay), #4580 (distinct-line argument for the H branch). A search of PRs and Discussion #1166 found no work on removing the query shears.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/thin-query-shear-floor
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/thin-query-shear-floor
```

Both pass (CPython 3.12, Windows, standard library only, under 1 s). Controls: single-call rank 1, an inserted SWAP breaks a window, a duplicated query line is detected.

## Credit

Controllers and replay model by 1337isnot1337 / Cinna Davis (#4440, #4470) and zxv; query-line sources from the retained native and PR589 BIT lineage. Prepared by Matarener (Mark) with substantial Claude Code assistance; no independent human review.

## Open next questions

A redesigned local family whose ports share query lines is the only opening part 3 leaves (the same as for the H branch). A general, non-gather lower bound for the fused block is open.
